arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-02' AND date < '2019-11-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated in the 30 days ending on 2019-10-31, the most recent day included.
assumptions: Last day of the data is 2019-10-31, so the 30-day window is 2019-10-02 through 2019-10-31 inclusive.
All transactions are counted, whether labelled or not, and regardless of amount sign or error status.
